name: Excel Splitter
description: Split Excel workbooks by sheet, column value, or complex rules
author: FengYu

aiTools.name: excel_analyze
aiTools.description: Analyze an Excel file and return sheets and headers.

aiTools.name: excel_configure
aiTools.description: Configure BY_SHEET, BY_COLUMN, or COMPLEX splitting.

aiTools.name: excel_complex_config
aiTools.description: Add, list, or clear complex split rules.

aiTools.name: excel_execute
aiTools.description: Execute the configured split synchronously. Suitable for small workbooks that finish within the declared timeout; for large workbooks use excel_execute_start instead.

aiTools.name: excel_execute_start
aiTools.description: Launch the configured split as a background job for large workbooks and return a jobId immediately. Poll excel_execute_status with a cursor to drain progress logs; call excel_cancel to abort. Requires a prior excel_analyze + excel_configure on the shared 'ai' session.

aiTools.name: excel_execute_status
aiTools.description: Poll the status of a split job started by excel_execute_start. Returns streamed logs from the cursor, the running status, and the final result (fileCount + files) when done.

aiTools.name: excel_query
aiTools.description: Query the active Excel split session.

aiTools.name: excel_cancel
aiTools.description: Cancel and clear the active Excel split session.
